headline: The aid decree for Ceuta's services, security and economic fabric will take effect this Thursday
summary: The Royal Decree-law on urgent social and economic measures for Ceuta, approved by the Council of Ministers, takes effect after publication in the BOE. The plan aims to boost the city's economy.
why: Ceuta is a Spanish autonomous city on the North African coast whose economy depends heavily on trade, services and public spending. Central government support measures can shift local demand and public finances.

original_headline: El decreto de ayudas para los servicios, seguridad y tejido económico de Ceuta entrará en vigor este jueves
